name: The Divine Speaker
source:
Strengths - ???
Weaknesses - ???

The Divine Speaker is the individual that communes with the gods to protect the lands and grants newborn children their Judgements. He's a kind man that gives up many luxuries to help those in need.

He's refered to by his title instead of his name, and is always seen in his white, gold and red ceremonial uniform.

[From the developer's [url=https://twitter.com/TwoHalfStudios/status/1099798090335154176/]official Twitter[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Aemyl.[/spoiler]
